newsitem.title: USA: Ocwen Financial files for capital offers.
newsitem.headline: Ocwen Financial files for capital offers.

text.p: Ocwen Financial Corp on Tuesday said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to proposed offerings of three million shares of common stock, plus up to 450,000 more shares to cover an over-allotment.
Ocwen also filed a statement for an offer by Ocwen Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust sponsored by the company, of $125 million of trust preferred capital securities.
Lehman Brothers will underwrite the sale of the common stock and trust preferred capital securities along with Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc and Morgan Stanley Dean Witter.
